scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace @idx-terminal/web && uv run --project apps/api ruff check apps/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @idx-terminal/web && uv run --project apps/api mypy apps/api/app
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @idx-terminal/web && uv run --project apps/api pytest -c apps/api/pyproject.toml apps/api/tests
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run test:e2e
